purpose: Independent practice of A8.2 (counting and tallying).
student_learning_goal: I can collect data by counting things in groups.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can collect data by counting things in groups.
header.character_watermark: Tally in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Count each sorted group. Tally each.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four sorted groups with tally areas.

image_placeholders.description: Four group boxes in B&W, ~7in x 3in. Each has objects pre-drawn (4 items, 6 items, 3 items, 8 items). Tally area below each. Header 'Count and Tally:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_COUNT: keywords (count, tally) name the activity.

parts.student_instructions: Count things in your classroom by colour. Tally each.

image_placeholders.description: A tally chart in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. 4 rows: red, blue, yellow, green. Tally areas. Header 'Classroom Count:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_CLASS: keywords (classroom) name the chart.

image_placeholders.description: A survey chart in B&W, ~7in x 2.5in. 4 colour rows with tally areas. Header 'My Survey (6 classmates):'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_SURVEY: keywords (my, survey) name the chart.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, survey 6 more classmates and tally.
